name: Unitec Fibres Limited
about: Unitec Fibres Private Limited manufactures polyester staple fibers. The company produces polyester staple fibers in solid and hollow forms, hollow conjugate fibers, fibers, dope dyed fibers, down-type fibers, non-woven materials, yarn for spinning, and textile fillings, along with biodegradable fibers using CiCLO technology. The company also provides Extended Producer Responsibility services, which include plastic waste collection and recycling operations. Unitec Fibres Limited was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
